title: Coastal and river mission
requirement: SHALL define patrol, community access, supervised emergency transport and handover scenarios within a validated coastal/river envelope.
cad_callout_or_derived_basis: CAD: use cases and reinforced hull
acceptance_criterion: Approve mission and envelope; demonstrate a representative supervised dispatch/transport/handover scenario.

title: Twin outboard arrangement
requirement: SHALL define the depicted twin-outboard propulsion arrangement and assess selected fuel/electric/hybrid alternatives without assuming simultaneous implementation.
cad_callout_or_derived_basis: CAD: twin outboards; fuel/electric hybrid label
acceptance_criterion: Compare selected drive with resistance/energy budget; test steering and local stop for its approved configuration.

title: Patient compartment
requirement: SHALL provide an arranged patient area for stretcher retention, selected monitoring and supervised telemedicine with accessible equipment.
cad_callout_or_derived_basis: CAD: patient area and modular equipment
acceptance_criterion: Inspect stretcher/equipment access and demonstrate transfer and monitoring workflow for approved occupancy.

title: Modular working deck
requirement: SHALL define deck equipment/rescue/cargo mounts, retention and clear working/boarding routes with controlled mass/CG.
acceptance_criterion: Review load/mount records and inspect access for each selected rescue/cargo configuration.

title: Solar and protected power
requirement: SHALL define roof PV and its protected conversion interface to the selected vessel energy system.
acceptance_criterion: Approve mounting/shading and power budget; test isolated charging and essential-load priority.

title: Navigation and communications
requirement: SHALL integrate selected GPS/GNSS, AIS, radar/cameras, VHF and optional cellular/satellite communications with local helm indication.
acceptance_criterion: Replay sensor/link faults; verify validity, operator status and approved degraded response.

title: Water and waste
requirement: SHALL provide separate fresh, grey and black water circuits/tanks with service access and approved capacities.
acceptance_criterion: Inspect independent circuits and demonstrate leakage/level response against the approved mission budgets.
